say:27:1012130008:1.text: Apologies, younglings. I did not mean to raise my voice. That wasn't directed at you. I was talking about that clod named Eironn.
say:27:1012130008:1.source_cn: 对不起啊年轻人！我刚才嗓门太大了。我凶的不是你，是那个...

say:1:1012131002:0.text: Don't take it personally. She didn't know who you were.
say:1:1012131002:0.source_cn: 你别往心里去啊，村长婆婆毕竟不认识你。

say:0:1012201001:0.text: Lovers' Wish... It's a very romantic place with many flowers.
say:0:1012201001:0.source_cn: 情人之愿，我听说那是个很浪漫的地方，开着不少鲜花。洛桑...

say:1:1012201002:0.text: I have no particular interest in flowers...

say:2:1012201003:0.text: Really? You used to ask me to weave flower garlands for you.
say:2:1012201003:0.source_cn: 哎？你现在不喜欢了？小时候，你经常让我编花环给你戴呢。

say:1:1012202001:1.text: Did we go the wrong way? How can this be Lovers' Wish?
say:1:1012202001:1.source_cn: 我们是不是走错路了？这里怎么可能是情人之愿呢？

say:2:1012202002:1.text: The corruption here is even worse than in Taran Village.
say:2:1012202002:1.source_cn: 这么可怕的地方，叫仇人之愿才对吧！地面的腐化竟然比塔兰...

say:4:1012202003:1.text: The leylines determine the flow of magic power. It's complicated as a river and just as hard to understand.
say:4:1012202003:1.source_cn: 地脉决定了魔力的流动，它就像错综复杂的河流，难以摸清走势。

say:5:1012202004:1.text: It seemed that the leylines here are directly connected to the Lucent Tree, so the effects of the corruption are more pronounced here.
say:5:1012202004:1.source_cn: 看来，这里的地脉与流荧树直接相连，因此受到的影响也更加明显。

say:6:1012202005:1.text: What about this Miss Hewynn that Granny Fennel was talking about? Since Lovers' Wish has become like this... is she still around?
say:6:1012202005:1.source_cn: 茴姆婆婆提到的那位伊温小姐呢？情人之愿都变成这样了……...

say:8:1012202006:1.text: The rain hasn't stopped. She is still here.

say:11:1012202007:1.text: Yes... the warm rain. This rain seems to wash away all the distracting thoughts in my heart.
say:11:1012202007:1.source_cn: 是啊，好温暖的雨。这场雨仿佛能洗净心中所有杂念。

say:12:1012202008:1.text: But where is she? There's not even a soul to be seen around here.
say:12:1012202008:1.source_cn: 可是……她在哪呢？这附近连个人影都看不着。

say:13:1012202009:1.text: Should we try calling her name? Granny Fennel said that she's very shy. Will it scare her away?
say:13:1012202009:1.source_cn: 我们喊她的名字试试？但茴姆婆婆说她很胆小，这么做会不会...

say:15:1012202011:1.text: I feel a powerful magical presence coming from <style="highlight">the pavilion at the center of the lake</style>. Why don't we go there first?

say:0:1012202101:0.text: There is magic up ahead. Hewynn should be nearby.
say:0:1012202101:0.source_cn: 前方的魔力较为集中，伊温应该就在附近，试着在那里呼唤她吧。

say:2:1012203001:0.text: Miss Hewynn, I know you're here. We've been tasked to ask for your help. In order to save the villagers, we require your dewdrops.
say:2:1012203001:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐，我知道你在。我们受人所托，想请你用露珠救助大家。

say:4:1012203003:0.text: If the rain stops, the corruption... will spread even more quickly. I-I can't stop it, but I can delay it...
say:4:1012203003:0.source_cn: 如果雨停了，灾难……会迅速蔓延。虽然我……无法阻止，但...

say:6:1012203004:0.text: Don't push yourself, Miss Hewynn! You sound exhausted... I'm afraid you won't be able to stop this corruption with your strength alone.
say:6:1012203004:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐，别硬撑啊！你听上去已经精疲力尽了……以你的力...

say:7:1012203005:0.text: If the rain stops... my friend... I must protect my friend...
say:7:1012203005:0.source_cn: 如果……雨停下来，我的朋友将会……不行！<style=...

say:8:1012203006:0.text: My friend is losing his memories... He will forget me and even... become my enemy.
say:8:1012203006:0.source_cn: 我的朋友快要失去理智了……他会永远忘记我，甚至……变成...

say:9:1012203007:0.text: Everyone... <style="highlight">please save my friend</style>. He's in the Floral Valley. He's gentle and fluffy, but right now, he's in a lot of pain.

say:10:1012203008:0.text: I will repay you. No matter what you need of me, I will help.
say:10:1012203008:0.source_cn: 我会报答大家，只要我能做到……让我做什么都可以。
